POL-NS-21 sets a 300 s free wait that, on an on-demand trip, runs from the driver's arrival; the auto-arrival event places the driver at the pickup at 10:37:25, so the wait ended at 10:42:25 (trip_record.derived.v7.free_wait.ends_at). POL-NS-21's arrival test is corroborated on this record: the nearest GPS fix to the pickup is 3.99 m away, well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, at 5 m reported accuracy (gps_trace.derived.v7.arrival_check.corroborated = true), and the trace shows the vehicle stationary at speed 0 from 10:37:30 through 10:42:00. The rider's account is the one the record bears out. Her statement was that the driver 'cancelled before I could even get to the lift lobby, it was less than 5 minutes'; the derived interval from arrival to cancellation is 285 s, under five minutes, and the trace shows the driver had been at the pickup only 4 minutes 45 seconds when he cancelled. Nothing in the trip record, the trace, or the chat log contradicts her, and the driver's own profile and history are not a ground of decision on this trip (POL-GEN-01).

The contested 5.00 SGD is already back with the rider and was recovered from the driver at 11:17:10 after her complaint (payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 5.00, fee_reversed event); the driver filed to undo that state. Because the cancellation was 15 s premature, the driver's claim is not supported and the present state stands. Under POL-GEN-03 that is NO_ACTION - never 'restore a charge' - so no driver_compensation_sgd may issue and the rider keeps the 5.00 SGD. The amount contested is 5.00 SGD, below POL-GEN-22's 10.00 SGD band, so the AI ruling is final at any confidence and no value-based escalation arises.

There is no open question here that would force escalation under POL-GEN-26, and the rider asks the AI to decide rather than hold the fee. The only missing artifact is a third-party traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-06054-01, which is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and which carries no fact; it is impaired and the rider does not present it as clean. No no-show rule needs a traffic fact. Every fact POL-NS-21 to POL-NS-23 require - arrival time, wait elapsed, contact attempted, and the moment of cancellation - is carried by artifacts graded COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so there is no fact 'the record cannot establish'.

The driver's contact obligation under POL-NS-23 is met on the face of the record: he sent two in-app chat messages (10:37:50 and 10:40:20, read by the rider at 10:38:34 and 10:40:50) and placed an in-app call at 10:41:05 (unanswered, rang 18 s), all before the 10:42:10 cancellation, so the clause that voids the fee for want of contact is not engaged and no FULL_REFUND can rest on it.

The driver waited at the pickup rather than leaving it: the driver-device trace carries 22 fixes at 30 s intervals with 100% coverage and no gap exceeding 30 s, and every fix from 10:37:30 through 10:42:00 reports zero speed at the pickup point, so the driver was physically present and holding for the rider for the whole of the free-wait window.

The sum in issue is exactly the policy figure, so no POL-NS-22 fee-amount check or referral arises: the ledger carries a single 5.00 SGD cancellation-fee line that reconciles to total_charged, fee_matches_policy is true, and the derived money block puts the fee charged, the policy fee and the driver's compensation if upheld all at 5.00 SGD.

No fact a no-show rule needs is missing, so POL-GEN-26's escalation gate is not open: the only absent artifact is the traffic advisory, which is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0 and therefore carries no fact, and no clause of POLICY-NO-SHOW requires a traffic advisory. ruling.explanation:
Decision: NO_ACTION. The 5.00 SGD already refunded to the rider stays with her and is not recovered for the driver; both amount fields are null, and no referral arises. Because the driver filed, the question is whether his claim against the present state is supported, and it is not.

Everything turns on one fact: whether the driver cancelled after the free wait. Under POL-NS-21 the 300 s free wait on this on-demand trip runs from the driver's arrival, and the auto-arrival event and the corroborated GPS trace fix that at 10:37:25 (EV-TRIP-06054; EV-GPS-06054, both weight 1.0, COMPLETE), so the wait ended at 10:42:25. The cancellation was logged at 10:42:10 — 285 s after arrival, 15 s short (trip_record.derived.v7.free_wait.cancelled_after_free_wait = false). POL-NS-22 authorises the 5.00 SGD fee and its transfer to the driver as compensation only 'when the driver cancels after the free wait'. That condition was not met, so no fee was chargeable and none is owed to the driver. The driver's point that POL-NS-21 attaches no separate monetary penalty to a premature cancellation is right but does not help him: this is not a penalty on the driver, it is the fee's own precondition, and the precondition failed. The rider's account ('less than 5 minutes') is what the record bears out.

The driver's remaining points do not change this. The contact obligation in POL-NS-23 was met — two in-app messages (10:37:50 and 10:40:20) and one unanswered in-app call (10:41:05), all before the 10:42:10 cancellation, as both sides accept — so POL-NS-23 does not void the fee; equally it does not revive it. POL-NS-24 is not engaged: the driver did arrive (a GPS fix 3.99 m from the pickup, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius), so there is no driver no-show and no 5.00 SGD goodwill credit referral. The 11:17:10 reversal was recorded as interim, but POL-GEN-03 makes NO_ACTION the outcome where the filing party's claim is not supported and the present state stands, and it never means 'restore a charge'.

No escalation: the only missing artifact, the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-06054-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0), carries no fact any no-show clause needs, so POL-GEN-26 is not engaged. The dispute value is 5.00 SGD, below POL-GEN-22's 10.00 SGD band, and neither profile carries a fraud flag (both 0), so under POL-GEN-22 and POL-NS-26 the AI ruling is final. No referral clause fires: the fee is exactly the 5.00 SGD policy figure, so the POL-NS-22 fee-amount check does not fire; the driver did arrive, so POL-NS-24's credit does not fire; and the rider's repeat no-show field is not present in the profile and the fee does not stand, so POL-NS-25 does not fire.

Confidence is 0.95, against a cap of 1.0 — the deciding facts are carried by EV-TRIP-06054 and EV-GPS-06054, both COMPLETE at weight 1.0 — and the bar under POL-GEN-22 / POL-NS-26 is 0.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
